coordinate_system: axisymmetric cylindrical half-plane (r,z), r in [0,R_wall], z periodic with period 1
description: Preregistered wall-dependence experiment (docs/wall_dependence_prereg.md): the E-32 C-infinity compact-support initial-data family integrated to T_1 on nested finite cylinders R_wall in {1, 1.5, 2, 3} at a fixed core spacing dr = 1/192, dz = 1/384, plus the resolution-consistency pair R_wall in {1, 2} at dr = 1/128
interpretation: This is a resolution-limited numerical observation of the wall-radius sensitivity of THIS discretization over THIS early time interval. It is not a reproduction of any published amplification value, not a singularity candidate, not a proof, and a small measured wall effect is not evidence of wall independence in the whole space.
normalization_description: Hou finite-cylinder normalization: u1 = u^theta/r, omega1 = omega^theta/r, psi1 = psi^theta/r; the E-29 amplitude 12000 is part of the audited equation and is multiplied by amplitude_scale, which exists only so that reduced-amplitude smoke runs can reuse this schema; the E-32 cutoff multiplies the whole datum by chi_c(r^2)

units.energy: dimensionless kinetic energy on the finite cylinder
